visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands holds two bundles of white, translucent dry vermicelli over a stainless steel bowl filled with water. The background is a clean, well-lit kitchen with a wooden countertop. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the fibrous texture of the noodles. (2) The hands submerge the vermicelli into the water bowl. In the background, a pink pan with a glass lid and other kitchen utensils are visible. The focus is on the bowl as the noodles begin to soak. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of a white onion on a yellow cutting board. A hand uses a large chef's knife to slice the onion into thick strips. The kitchen environment remains consistent with bright, flat lighting. (4) Hands continue prep by slicing green scallions diagonally on the same yellow board. The white parts and green parts are separated into piles. The camera angle is a high-angle close-up, focusing purely on the rhythmic knife movements. (5) The scallion greens are shown being picked up, displaying their fresh, vibrant green color. The lighting emphasizes the moisture on the leaves. The background is slightly blurred, keeping focus on the hand and the vegetables. (6) A small white rectangular grater is used to turn a clove of garlic into paste. Then, various liquids like soy sauce and mirin are poured into a small white bowl. A wooden spoon is used to mix the dark sauce. (7) Bundles of green leafy vegetables and white bean sprouts in a metal strainer are shown. Then, a hand uses a vegetable peeler to shred a bright orange carrot into thin strips over a white oval plate. (8) The soaked vermicelli is drained in a metal strainer and then cut with black kitchen scissors. The noodles are now soft and pliable. The camera remains in a close-up shot of the hands performing these actions. (9) Ingredients are layered in a pink non-stick pan: first onion strips and scallion whites, followed by the vermicelli, shredded carrots, bean sprouts, more onion, the dark sauce, and water. Finally, green bok choy leaves are packed on top. (10) A tray of thin, raw red beef slices is presented. The hands carefully lay the beef slices over the bed of green vegetables in the pan. Black pepper is ground over the beef using a manual mill. (11) The pan is covered with a glass lid and placed on a portable white stove. The heat is turned on. After some time, steam builds up inside the lid, obscuring the view of the beef and vegetables slightly. (12) The lid is lifted, revealing the cooked ingredients. A hand uses wooden chopsticks and a black spatula to mix the noodles, beef, and vegetables together. Sesame oil is drizzled over the dish, followed by fresh scallion greens. (13) The final dish is plated on a decorative white plate with French text. A close-up shows the glistening noodles, tender beef, and colorful vegetables. The woman appears at the end, wearing a pink apron, tasting the dish with chopsticks and smiling.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody in a major key, accompanied by a rhythmic shaker. The sound of dry noodles rustling against hands and a metal bowl is heard, followed by the soft splash of water. (2) A series of sharp, rhythmic thuds and clicks follow as a knife chops through a crisp onion on a wooden surface. The BGM remains steady, providing an upbeat background to the precise acoustic texture of the vegetable preparation. (3) High-pitched, scratchy sounds of garlic being grated on a ceramic surface occur, followed by the hollow clinking of glass and plastic as sauces are poured. The sound of a wooden spoon stirring liquid in a bowl is clearly audible. (4) Fast, crisp scraping sounds of a peeler against a carrot create a rapid percussive effect. This is followed by the metallic click of scissors cutting through wet noodles and the soft rustle of vegetables being moved. (5) The sound of the stove burner clicking to ignite is followed by a low-frequency hiss. As the lid is placed on the pot, a dull thud occurs. The BGM continues throughout, maintaining a cheerful atmosphere. (6) A sudden burst of hissing steam marks the cooking phase. When the lid is lifted, a metallic clatter is heard, followed by the wet, squelching sounds of the ingredients being mixed with wooden chopsticks. (7) The final sequence features the soft crunching sound of the woman chewing the noodles. The BGM swells slightly as the video concludes, with the acoustic guitar strumming a final resolving chord.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Preparation -> Cooking -> Plating -> Tasting -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a step-by-step instructional guide for making a simple beef and vermicelli pot. It uses a high-paced editing style and ASMR-like audio to make the cooking process look easy, efficient, and appetizing, ultimately encouraging viewers to try the recipe at home and follow the creator's social media accounts.
